facts.content: Overuse knee strain or running-related musculoskeletal pain is considered most likely.

facts.content: Meniscal tear is considered in the differential diagnosis.
facts.source_text: Meniscal tear (consider if mechanical symptoms persist or worsen, particularly with clicking, instability, or joint line tenderness).
